title: Pure Magical Musket
summary: Pure Magical Musket control build with generic Fiend and Link payoffs. Magical Musketeers allow you to activate archetype Spells and Traps directly from your hand during either player's turn, triggering column-aligned card advantage and targeted disruptions.

summary.title: Starters
points: Magical Musketeer Caspar adds any Magical Musket card with a different name from your Deck to your hand whenever a Spell or Trap Card is activated in its column.
Magical Musketeer Starfire Special Summons any Level 4 or lower Magical Musketeer monster from your Deck in Defense Position whenever a Spell or Trap is activated in its column.
Magical Musketeer Kidbrave discards a Magical Musket card to draw two cards whenever a Spell or Trap resolves in its column.
Magical Musketeer Doc recycles a Magical Musket card with a different name from your GY back to your hand whenever a Spell or Trap resolves in its column.

summary.title: Opening: Magical Musketeer Caspar + Any Spell/Trap
steps: Normal Summon Magical Musketeer Caspar in a Main Monster Zone.
Activate any Spell or Trap Card in Caspar's column (such as a staple Spell or Magical Musket - Crooked Crown).
Caspar triggers in response, adding Magical Musket - Desperado or Magical Musket - Last Stand from your Deck to your hand.
With a Magical Musketeer on the field, you can now activate your newly searched quick-play Spells and Traps directly from your hand during either player's turn to disrupt the opponent.
On following turns, Link Summon Magical Musketeer Max to replenish your hand with Spells and Traps or field monsters according to your opponent's board size.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Magical Musketeer Max is a Link-1 that searches Magical Musket Spells/Traps up to the number of monsters your opponent controls, or Special Summons Magical Musketeer monsters from the Deck up to the number of Spells/Traps they control.

Magical Musket Mastermind Zakiel can be Tribute Summoned with a single Magical Musketeer, and draws cards during the opponent's End Phase equal to the number of Magical Musket Spells/Traps activated that turn while face-up.
D/D/D Wave High King Caesar provides Quick Effect negation and destruction against Special Summons or effects that include Special Summoning.
S:P Little Knight banishes a card on the field or in the GY on summon and banishes two face-up monsters until the End Phase as a Quick Effect.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Magical Musket - Desperado targets and destroys a face-up card on the field.
Magical Musket - Cross-Domination targets a face-up monster to change its ATK and DEF to 0 and negate its effects until the end of the turn.
Magical Musket - Last Stand negates the activation of an opponent's Spell or Trap Card and destroys it while you control a Magical Musketeer.
Magical Musket - Dancing Needle banishes up to three cards from either GY, cutting off opponent recursion.
Magical Musket - Crooked Crown Special Summons a Magical Musketeer from the hand and locks the Main Monster Zone directly opposite it.
Magical Musket - Fiendish Deal prevents Magical Musketeers from being destroyed by card effects and searches a Magical Musket card if sent to the GY by an opponent's card.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Magical Musket Mastermind Caspar is excluded because it has not yet been released in the TCG.
